vísur:
The amber canopy fell, and rusted steel sang
Leaves turned copper, while bright silver sphere rose
A soft hum of latent power drifted through the loam
The furnace of autumn blazed, and strength lay dormant
When twilight equalizes, steel will pulse beneath fallen bark
Silver sphere will widen, spilling radiance onto trembling roots
Hidden currents of power will stir, and strength will rise like tide
The world will kindle, and we will walk beyond the veil

háttr: Tvau erindi, fjórar línur hvert. Hit fyrra í fortíð, hit síðara í framtíð; hvárugt í nútíð.
